def rgb_to_hsv(r, g, b):
    r, g, b = r / 255.0, g / 255.0, b / 255.0
    max_c = max(r, g, b)
    min_c = min(r, g, b)
    delta = max_c - min_c

    # Hue calculation
    if delta == 0:
        h = 0
    elif max_c == r:
        h = 60 * (((g - b) / delta) % 6)
    elif max_c == g:
        h = 60 * (((b - r) / delta) + 2)
    else:
        h = 60 * (((r - g) / delta) + 4)

    # Saturation calculation
    s = 0 if max_c == 0 else delta / max_c

    # Value calculation
    v = max_c

    return round(h, 1), round(s * 100, 1), round(v * 100, 1)
